summary: Ryman Hospitality Properties filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a quarterly cash dividend of $1.20 per common share, payable October 15, 2026, to holders of record as of September 30, 2026. Its operating partnership subsidiary, RHP Hotel Properties LP, declared a matching $1.20 per OP Unit distribution on the same timetable. The filing notes the dividend is treated as a dividend described under 29 CFR 4043.31(a) for the company's frozen defined benefit pension plan, and recipients are not plan controlled-group members. This mirrors three prior identical 2026 quarterly dividends; no special-situation transaction is present.
